# FLOORLINE — React version — live preview

Real Chromium screenshots of the actual React build running (`react-app/dist/index.html`,
bundled offline with esbuild from the source in `react-app/src/`, using React 19). Not mockups —
captured with Playwright while the simulation was ticking and after real user interaction
(role switch, plant switch, typing in the search box).

## 1. Live alert with AI explanation (Plant A — Austin)

![React dashboard with a live alert](data:image/png;base64,)

## 2. Plant switched to Katowice, manual search with a real cache hit

Typed "conveyor jam", then "spindle vibration", then "conveyor jam" again —
the second identical query hits the in-memory cache (`cached` badge, footer
shows real accumulated hit/lookup counts from every keystroke).

![React manual retrieval cache hit](data:image/png;base64,)

## 3. Operator role — Export CSV disabled, footer reads "role: view-only"

![React operator role locked](data:image/png;base64,)

## Reproduce it yourself

```bash
unzip floorline-react.zip
cd react-app
# option A — zero install, already built:
open dist/index.html        # (or just double-click it)

# option B — normal dev workflow:
npm install
npm run dev
```
